name: Turpaz Industries Ltd
summary: Turpaz Industries Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, marketing, and sale of scents in Israel, the Middle East, North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Taste, Fragrances, and Specialty Fine Ingredients segments. The Taste segment develops, produces, markets, and sells natural and synthetic sweet and savory taste extracts, seasonings, functional solutions for the baking industry, raw materials for the meat and baking industries, and special gluten free flour for the production of food and beverages.
